newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 6.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Interpublic Group has acquired a majority stake infilm and TV management and production company Addis-Wechsler.
* A $323 million writeoff at Blockbuster pushed its parent company, Viacom, into a $210 million loss for the second quarter.
* Sony Pictures releases on Tuesday reached $900 million for the year, and around Labor Day the studio will become only the second company to gross $1 billion domestically in a calendar year.
* "The Keenen Ivory Wayans Show" and "Vibe" averaged a 3.9 rating and nine household share and a 3.1/7, respectively, in their debuts Monday according to Nielsen's top 38 overnight "metered" markets.
* UPN said it filed suit to prevent Sinclair Communications from switching to the WB, while Sinclair CEO-designate Barry Baker threatened retribution.
* Iwerks Entertainment and Showscan announced plans Tuesday to merge.
